task.title: To view and edit a condition

step.cmd: Open Microsoft Word and log in to X-Author for Contracts Advanced for Conga CLM (Contracts for Salesforce).
From the Contracts pane, click the Home button ) and select Templates.
In the Templates pane, go to Work > Clauses.
Select a clause or clause bundle from the clauses list.
Click the Settings icon () next to the clause or clause bundle. This opens the Properties page and you can see the condition expression set for that clause or clause bundle.
To edit the condition, click the Edit icon () next to Condition.
